what: When the panel’s top edge reaches 70% of the screen (once), the 1px grid lines inside are drawn all at once — vertical lines top to bottom, horizontal lines left to right over 2.4s (ease). In a layout with three vertical lines per section (center and both ends) and horizontal lines above and below each block, lines get drawn whenever a section enters.

options.[data-fx-part=vline]: Vertical line (position·color set by the consuming css — usually absolute, 1px, height 100%)
options.[data-fx-part=hline]: Horizontal line (usually absolute, 1px high, screen width)

from.where: The frame on every page (.cn-frame — original _6Ibhoq_frame: ScrollTrigger top 70% once → data-line-active, lineVertical scaleY · lineHorizontal scaleX transition 2.4s)
